lessons.trigger_condition: External app and collector research showed that stale prices, asking-price confusion, incorrect parallels, and inability to retain evidence locally are recurring trust failures after card scanning.
lessons.prevention_rule: Preserve and expose source-date freshness, downgrade confidence for old or unknown evidence, require explicit variant selection when the same card number has multiple observed printings, and provide local CSV/JSON evidence export without cloud upload.
validation_required: source dates normalize into the existing FRESH/AGING/STALE/EXPIRED/UNKNOWN contract
recommendation output reports freshness and cannot silently upgrade stale or unknown evidence
ambiguous observed print variants expose a bounded selector and rerun the existing identity/evidence pipeline
CSV and JSON exports preserve recommendation provenance and source URLs without secrets or cloud transfer
tcg-market-freshness, tcg-card-variant-resolution, and tcg-local-evidence-export are mirrored and routed
full tablet runtime, integrity, sync, SELFREFINE and CodeQL guards pass before merge
lessons.safety_boundary: Social/search research is discovery-only; it never promotes a card price, grade, stock or market direction. Physical tablet verification remains separate.
